purpose.seed: Reproducible canopy variants; never consumes native gameplay randomness.
purpose.height_m: Source height in game metres before the stated root burial; not a change to native bodies.
purpose.sprays: Connected branchlets supporting a layered broadleaf crown or irregular conifer tiers.
purpose.leaf_length_m: Broadleaf leaf size or pine needle-bearing shoot length, with natural variation.
purpose.trunk_triangles: Explicit near/middle/far candidate mesh targets retaining bark, forks and silhouettes; measured below, not approved production budgets.
purpose.cut_height_m: Matching stump cut plane in this source; supplies presentation only for existing finite felling.
purpose.burial_m: Seat reconstructed root tips in review ground; not world-generation height tuning.
purpose.lod_distances_m: Review switches after 18 and 55 metres; near leaf edges, middle folded clusters and distant branch-linked silhouettes.
purpose.wind_tip_m: Maximum leaf-tip cosmetic offset; zero at attachment sockets.
purpose.wind_period_seconds: Slow pause-aware foliage sway, no simulation effect.
purpose.scar: Ten-centimetre maximum geometric incision under a broad broken margin; narrower recessed energy follows the approved oak paths. Four-second ambient pulse, never work or success.
